grid-overlapping-plates.json.why: Two plates cover cell [1, 0] and cell [3, 0] is left bare.

grid-uncovered-cell.json.why: Cell [3, 1] is covered by no plate.

grid-floor-too-thin.json.why: A Large groove in 12 mm stock leaves a 2.5 mm floor, under the 5.5 mm minimum.

grid-loose-plates-offer-clamp.json.why: Grooves between loose plates are offered for clamp loads before test T-20 has passed.

grid-no-open-groove-end.json.why: All four edges are margins with stopped cross grooves, so no slide key can enter, and the face does not declare that.

grid-fold-over-limit.json.why: Standard loose Small plates on both faces of a 270 degree fold meet below the surface: the limit is 265 degrees.

grid-routed-with-loose-plate.json.why: A routed integral face has no loose plates. A face with some is build mode cut-down-sites.

grid-fold-not-declared.json.why: An edge names a fold that the record does not define.

plate-sheet-square-edges.json.why: A sheet-cut plate with square edges forms a straight slot, not a dovetail.

plate-span-under-minimum.json.why: A Gridfinity plate needs 2 x 2 cells for one bin.

plate-kind-unknown.json.why: The kind is not in the kind registry.

plate-carries-no-target.json.why: A plate of a kind that carries another system does not state its target.

plate-kind-not-in-small.json.why: The T-track kind is Large only: the track is deeper than a Small plate.

key-slide-too-short.json.why: A slide key under 16 mm loses both walls at a groove crossing.

key-small-m6-printed.json.why: A printed Small nut cannot hold an M6 thread or nut: Small M6 nuts are metal.

key-neck-too-wide.json.why: A neck of 8.0 does not pass an opening at its lower limit of 7.90.

key-snap-offered-for-clamp.json.why: Snap keys are not offered for clamp loads.

claim-line-not-derived.json.why: The claim line differs from the line derived from the record.

third-party-no-disclaimer.json.why: A third-party part does not carry the required statement.

gauge-out-of-limits.json.why: The go blade measures 7.80 against a stated 7.90: more than 0.05 out.

version-not-semver.json.why: The version is not the one full version string.

adapter-plate-without-span.json.why: An adapter on a plate does not state the plate's span.
